sources.title: Fine-tuning | QwenLM/Qwen3-VL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides a high-level overview of fine-tuning Qwen3-VL models on custom multimodal datasets. The fine-tuning framework is contained within the qwen-vl-finetune/ directory and supports training on images, videos, and grounding tasks using various optimization strategies like DeepSpeed and LoRA.

sources.title: Fine-tuning Overview | QwenLM/Qwen3-VL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page introduces the fine-tuning framework architecture, core components, and training workflow for Qwen-VL models. The framework is located in the qwen-vl-finetune/ directory and provides a complete pipeline for adapting pretrained Qwen2VL, Qwen2.5VL, and Qwen3VL models (including Dense and MoE variants) to custom multimodal datasets.
